notes: Standard WooCommerce (Avada/Fusion theme). Stock status is a WooCommerce class ('instock'/'outofstock') on the product_container li itself, not a separate nested element — check the container's own class list rather than querying '.instock' as a descendant. Page 1 has no /page/1/ suffix; pages 2-5 use /page/N/. Ticket 17: '/ennakkotilaukset/' is the shop's preorder category, 27 products at audit time of which 20 are Pokémon and the rest Lorcana/World of Tanks — the shop offers no way to scope it (a '?tuote-osasto=pokemon' filter is ignored, '/tuote-osasto/pokemon/?product_cat=ennakkotilaukset' 404s), so those few non-Pokémon listings are the price of preorder coverage here. '/ennakkotilaukset/page/2/' returns an empty page, which ends pagination cleanly. Ticket 18: 'insufficientstock' added to the class map; it appears on 28 of 132 cards and always alongside 'outofstock' today, so mapping it changes nothing now but keeps a card that carries it alone out of unknown. 2026-09-02: span.price holds two amounts, '15,90 € <small class="woocommerce-price-suffix">12,67 €</small>' — the second is the same price without VAT (x 1.255), not a sale price, and no other WooCommerce shop in site_configs fills that suffix. Last-token-wins was storing the ex-VAT one, so every price here sat 25.5 % under what the shop charges and the shop looked like the cheapest in the country by a wide margin. The parser now strips .woocommerce-price-suffix; sale prices still come from <ins> as before.
